summary: Backend testing for SageChat complete. All 21 pytest tests pass (19 REST + 2 WebSocket). Covered: /api/ health, auth guards (missing/invalid/valid Bearer), /api/auth/me, user search (self-exclusion, partial name & email case-insensitive), conversations (create, idempotency, self-400, bad-peer-404, list sorted desc), messages (text/image/video with correct last_message previews '📷 Photo' & '🎥 Video', empty-text 400, non-participant 404, list sorted ASC), logout invalidates session, WS /api/ws (invalid token closes with 4401, valid token receives 'connected' + peer 'message' event), and MongoDB _id never leaked in any response.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, informational).
CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api_router); this still works but ordering convention is to add middleware before routers (informational).
seed_data_creation: Per-test stub users + sessions inserted into MongoDB via pytest fixtures (users prefixed with 'TEST_' / 'user_TEST_' and tokens prefixed 'TEST_tok_'). Automatically cleaned up in fixture teardown (users, sessions, conversations, and messages for those conversations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite lives in /app/backend/tests/. conftest.py creates stub users (alice/bob/charlie) directly in MongoDB using MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env, and cleans up after each test. Use fixture `user_alice`, `user_bob`, `user_charlie` and helper `auth(token)` for headers. WebSocket tests use wss:// derived from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v`.
